name: Alibi Ale Works

address.landmarkLong: Across from Raley’s, with parking on site and nearby.

happyHour: Weekday happy hour, Mon–Fri 3–5pm (excludes holiday periods)

policies.label: Bringing a dog
policies.text: Leashed dogs are welcome in the Beer Forest and on the lower patio, but not indoors.

policies.label: Outdoor seating
policies.text: The heated deck is available when weather allows. The Beer Forest is seasonal.

policies.label: Parking
policies.text: 45 spaces on site, with more parking nearby.

policies.label: To go
policies.text: Pizza and food for pickup, plus crowlers, growlers, cans, bottles, merch and gift cards.

gatherings.capacity: For groups of up to 200. Depending on your group size, you may need to book the whole pub.
features: An indoor stage with house sound and a video projector
An outdoor stage in the Biergarten
Open floor plan: no private banquet rooms
Live bands and a cocktail bar on request
Beer, wine, cider, soft drinks, kombucha and cocktails on draft

facts.since: Alibi Ale Works was founded in Incline Village in 2014
facts.awards: Voted Best Brewery in Truckee & North Lake Tahoe 11 times in the Sierra Sun's Best Of contest
facts.epa: A 2024 EPA Pollution Prevention Recognition Award, for brewing methods that save about 2,600 lbs of CO₂ a year
facts.glutenReduced: Brewed gluten-reduced, though not recommended for anyone with celiac disease
facts.community: In 2025, Alibi supported 94 non-profits and community groups across 106 events.

anonymous: Alibi Anonymous members ($15 a month or $150 a year) get $2 off 16oz beers, $1 off 10oz beers, and 10% off food, cans, fills and merch.
credits: Photos and can artwork were sourced from Alibi’s website for this private concept. Public-use permissions and complete photo credits still need confirmation.
The illustrations are artistic interpretations of Alibi, not exact views of the venue.
toGo: Last to-go order 8:45pm; online pickup slots show at checkout
newsletterLine: New beers, food and events, first.
